definition.command: set -e; pkgs=$(env -u CARGO_TARGET_DIR cargo tree --locked --edges normal --prefix none --format '{p}' | sort -u | grep '^suprnova v' || true); echo "suprnova packages in the normal build:"; echo "$pkgs"; test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pkgs" | grep -c .)" -eq 1; feats=$(env -u CARGO_TARGET_DIR cargo tree --locked --edges normal,features --invert suprnova --prefix none); if printf '%s\n' "$feats" | grep 'suprnova feature "testing"'; then echo 'the normal build turns on suprnova/testing'; exit 1; fi; echo 'one suprnova, no testing feature'
